subject: Kickoff: Redwood Console + API enablement for NanoBank
messages:
From: Cassandra Park <cassandra.park@nanobank.co>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@nanobank.co>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Redwood Console + API enablement for NanoBank

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to move to an onboarding cadence so our product and eng teams can start integration work. We have two distinct groups that need slightly different sessions:

- Product/ops: Console deep-dive (UI, RBAC, observability) — ~60–75 min
- Eng/platform: API enablement + hands-on lab (auth, samples, postman/curl, test keys) — ~90 min

Because the teams are in mixed time zones (SF and New York), would it be possible to run these as two shorter, focused sessions across the week? Ideally the console session the morning of Aug 25 (PDT) and the API lab the afternoon of Aug 26 (EDT), but we’re flexible.

Attendees: I’ll confirm final headcount but approx 6 product/ops and 4 engineers. Also we need a short preflight checklist for network/IP allowlist and temporary test creds.

Can you propose times and who from Redwood will lead each session?

Appreciate it —
Cassandra
Cassandra Park
Head of Integrations, NanoBank

[Attachment: nanobank_risk_profile.pdf (PDF)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Cassandra Park <cassandra.park@nanobank.co>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@nanobank.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Redwood Console + API enablement for NanoBank

Hi Cassandra — thanks for the clear split, that helps a lot. We can definitely run two focused sessions. Proposed plan:

1) Console deep-dive (60 min) — Tue, 25 Aug 2026 at 09:30 PDT / 12:30 EDT — lead: Sean Gallagher (product playbook + runbook)
2) API enablement + hands-on lab (90 min) — Wed, 26 Aug 2026 at 14:00 EDT / 11:00 PDT — lead: Monica Patel (API integration + lab)

Both sessions will include: short walkthrough, live Q&A, and a 30-min troubleshooting office-hours block immediately after the API lab (optional). I’ve attached a short console agenda and the API lab prep doc — please skim the prep items (IP allowlist, test creds) and let us know if you want the lab to use your staging or our sandbox.

If those times work, I’ll send calendar invites and add the preflight checklist to the Drive folder. If you prefer different times, say which blocks you’d like and we’ll adapt.

Quick asks:
- Confirm attendee list and timezone for each attendee
- Indicate whether engineers can access staging or need sandbox keys

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0137

[Attachment: console_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: Redwood Console + API enablement for NanoBank

Monica / Sean — forwarding Cassandra’s note. Proposed slots above. Quick split of responsibilities:

- Sean: lead Console deep-dive (Tue 8/25 morning PDT). Focus: RBAC, dashboards, cost breakdowns, rollout controls.
- Monica: lead API enablement + lab (Wed 8/26 afternoon EDT). Focus: auth flows, sample code, sandbox keys, lab troubleshooting.

Also need:
- Sean: 15-min preflight with product/ops owners day before session to confirm access
- Monica: test credentials & IP allowlist steps documented in the prep doc; can you own follow-up with security if they need SOC2 evidence?

If either of you want to swap or adjust timing, speak now — otherwise I’ll confirm with Cassandra and send invites.

— Lauren

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Kickoff: Redwood Console + API enablement for NanoBank

Lauren / Sean — I’m happy to take the API lab. A couple of logistics:

- For the lab I recommend using our sandbox (faster to onboard) unless NanoBank wants to test against their staging; if they want staging we’ll need the IP allowlist and a short run of test keys.
- I’ll prepare a 90-min lab script with checkpoints and a small Postman collection. I’ll drop the lab notes in the Drive folder by Tue EOD.
- I’ll loop in Security only if NanoBank requests SOC2 artifacts or long-term access — otherwise we can share the standard onboarding checklist.

Sean — I’ll coordinate with you for the 15-min console preflight; I suggest Wed morning UTC for buffer but we can be flexible.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: api_lab-setup.md (MD)]

Thanks — those slots work for us. Confirming final schedule:

- Tue, 25 Aug 2026 — Console deep-dive, 09:30–10:30 PT (12:30–13:30 ET) — lead: Sean Gallagher
- Wed, 26 Aug 2026 — API enablement + hands-on lab, 14:00–15:30 ET (11:00–12:30 PT) — lead: Monica Patel

What we’ve added for you:

If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to getting NanoBank integrated.

Best —
